summary: Allows trusted plugin and system routes to authorize against the active tenant without hard-coding a tenant identifier.
userImpact: Tenant-scoped plugin and system pages now render when the signed-in user has the declared tenant permission.
security: Route authorization still uses the server-provided permission snapshot and now binds an omitted tenant resource identifier to that snapshot's active tenant.
documentation: The generated technical release notes describe current-tenant authorization for trusted extension routes.
rollback: Redeploy the previous frontend host package or frontend image; no database rollback is required.
validation: The extension route authorization suite covers active-tenant resource inference and continues to reject missing or unknown authorization metadata.
